Subject: Supply chain breadcrumbs & onshore scope — evidence & timeline

Hi Camila,

Thanks for taking this — Avalon is running a SIG/CAIQ check as part of our final security review. To close the loop we need a short "supply chain breadcrumbs" package that includes:

- A current subprocessor roster (CSV or spreadsheet) with columns for company, service provided, processing location (country), and whether they handle sensitive data (PHI/PII).
- A KMS custody map indicating who holds keys (Redwood KMS / customer-managed / HSM) for any subprocessor that stores or processes customer data.
- A concise dataflow diagram (PDF) showing ingress -> processing -> egress for Avalon customer data.
- A one-paragraph attestation confirming whether any processing tied to Avalon accounts occurs outside the US (we need to know which providers, countries, and whether onshore-fallbacks exist).

We'd like the initial roster and KMS map within 72 hours, and the diagram + attestation within 5 business days. Please let me know if you need a template.

Also: is a redacted CSV acceptable for the public-facing vendor names? If not, we can coordinate an NDA addendum.

Attachments: Avalon_SIG_questions.pdf (Q sheet from our audit team)

Best,
Claire Park
Senior Security Ops, Avalon Health
audit@avalonhealth.com
